tagline: Modern, Fuel-Efficient Fleet of Mid-Size Product and Chemical Tankers
hero_kpi_rationale: The number of vessels is the primary indicator of operational scale and transportation capacity in the maritime shipping sector, directly reflecting the company's competitive position and potential revenue.

kpis.name: Fleet Size
kpis.explanation: Total number of product and chemical tankers operated by the company.
kpis.description: The fleet includes 25 owned tankers (20 MR and 5 chemical) and 1 chartered-in tanker.
kpis.signal: Modern fleet with an average age of 10.9 years

kpis.name: Owned Vessels
kpis.explanation: Number of vessels owned outright by the company.
kpis.description: Out of 26 total vessels, 25 are owned, reflecting a direct investment strategy and full operational control.
kpis.signal: Vast majority of the fleet held under direct ownership

kpis.name: Fleet Composition
kpis.explanation: Breakdown of the fleet between MR tankers and chemical tankers.
kpis.description: The fleet consists of 20 MR (Mid-Range product tankers) and 6 chemical tankers, leveraging overlap between the CPP and chemical sectors.
kpis.signal: Diversification across oil and chemical product sectors

risks.title: Cyclicality and volatility of oil tanker freight rates
risks.score_rationale: Risk ranked first in Risk Factor Summary and extensively detailed (paragraphs 1-2 of RISKS RELATED TO OUR INDUSTRY). Intense language: « cyclical and volatile », « prolonged downturn », « unpredictable ». Stable but structural trend. Maximum category weight: directly affects operational profitability.

risks.title: Dependence on geopolitically unstable trade routes
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned three times in Risk Factor Summary and developed across two full pages (Ukraine conflict, Strait of Hormuz, Red Sea, Venezuela). Highly intense language: « significantly disrupted », « material adverse impact », « unpredictable ». Trend up: new risks (Houthi attacks since December 2023, US seizures in Venezuela). Direct impact on routes, rates, and expenses.

risks.title: Cyberattacks and failures of critical IT systems
risks.score_rationale: Listed third in Risk Factor Summary. Dedicated, detailed paragraph with explicit mention of AI in cyberattacks. Intense language: « vulnerable », « increased in number and sophistication », « significant capital ». Trend up: new mention of AI. Risk specific to vessel control and operations.

risks.title: Charterer and commercial counterparty default risk
risks.score_rationale: Listed fourth in Risk Factor Summary. Detailed paragraph explaining reliance on chartering contracts and commercial pools. Moderate but clear language: « counterparty risks », « depressed market conditions ». Stable trend. Business-specific risk: charterers' ability to honor contracts.

risks.title: Overcapacity in oil tanker transportation and rate compression
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned in Risk Factor Summary (« An over-supply of tanker capacity »). Developed in the context of supply (newbuilding deliveries, scrapping rates). Clear language: « reductions in charter rates, vessel values, and profitability ». Stable but structural trend. Direct impact on competitiveness.

risks.title: Operational risks related to vessel damage and downtime
risks.score_rationale: Listed in Risk Factor Summary (« damage due to inherent operational risks », « unexpected drydocking costs »). Dedicated paragraph mentioning inherent risks of maritime navigation. Moderate language: « may suffer damage », « unexpected costs ». Stable trend. Business-specific risk related to fleet operations.

risks.title: Dependence on a third-party manager and operational continuity risks
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in Risk Factor Summary (« dependence on our third-party manager »). Risk specific to Ardmore's model (outsourced management). Moderate language. Stable trend. Indirect but significant impact on operational continuity.

risks.title: Shortage of qualified seafarers and rising labor costs
risks.score_rationale: Listed in Risk Factor Summary (« hire or retain qualified seafarers »). Dedicated paragraph highlighting recruitment challenges. Moderate language: « may not be able to hire or retain ». Trend up: structural shortage post-COVID. Direct impact on operating costs.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence or AI technologies as a strategic lever. The company references cybersecurity (SIEM and SOC) but does not position AI as a differentiating factor.
evidence: No reference to AI, machine learning, or AI-based automation
Focus on energy efficiency, fleet management, and environmental compliance
Mentioned technological tools (SIEM, SOC) are standard cybersecurity, not AI
